items.statement: The validated calculation supports the authors' qualitative structural hypothesis only to the extent demonstrated by the submitted geometry and multipoles: M3 is planar/N···S locked, has a cancelled or small net dipole, and has a substantial stacking-axis quadrupole within the declared convention.
items.expected: A bounded, evidence-based conclusion linking the independently computed structure and multipoles to the qualitative hypothesis, including model and isolated-molecule limitations.
